research_metadata.coverage_notes: Kalikot district has limited higher education infrastructure. Tiligufa Multiple Campus and a few community-based campuses affiliated with Tribhuvan University or Mid-Western University operate locally. This record captures the primary recognized constituent/community campus in the district.
